title: The browser is a second compile target, not a second language
scope:
a `wasm32` compile target for interactive client-side scripts running in a browser tab; its
codegen backend and how it shares the CFG/SSA IR boundary from M2; the per-target capability matrix that
excludes `spawn worker`/`spawn script`, coroutine-based suspension, and `.nvsx` wasm-component extensions
for this target only; the new `Core` host-context domain for DOM/window interaction; `require`'s
build-time-only resolution when there is no filesystem to fall back on.
validatedBy:
nothing, and nothing will — the backend was never built.
`benches/abi-probe/tests/wasm_sandbox.rs` remains and is unaffected: it holds
[0003](0003.md)'s extension-sandbox properties, which are wasm as a *host*, the
opposite direction from this ADR's target.
